Luanshi contributors fitted the original body to the river-gate saddle, bit, hoof and cart coordinates, transferred authored skin groups into the shared low-cost pose, filtered the four pigments and retained the hair coverage mask. The project saddle, tack, cart and wheel geometry are separate. Individual source hashes and the converter are in tools/art/import_remount.py.
